incident: Checkout DB pool exhaustion during flash sale
symptoms: DB connection count reached pool maximum
API latency rose sharply after traffic increased
recent_changes: See root-cause context; synthetic historical incident.
root_cause: Connection pool size remained at 20 while traffic increased 3x during a flash sale.
failed_attempts: Restarted checkout pods without changing pool configuration
successful_steps: Raised DB pool max to 60 after confirming DB had capacity
Reduced connection leak by upgrading the DB client version
resolution: Traffic surge exposed an undersized connection pool and a client-side connection leak. Increasing capacity and fixing the client leak restored normal checkout latency.
postmortem: Avoid blindly restarting pods; the symptom returned.
CPU scaling did not address the exhausted DB connections.
